versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
The helper connects through Beatra's mainland network when your computer is in mainland China, and can open the approval page on Beatra's international site when you need another sign-in method.
The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

ai-music-video-clip-maker v0.1.4

- Refined scope: clarified that the skill requires a finished song/excerpt and focuses only on making short music-driven clips (not song generation).
- Updated input requirements: users must now select a clip route (performance, narrative, lyric-led, or visualization); default guidance recommends using a strong 20–30 second section.
- Expanded guidance on respecting song rights: emphasized staying in planning if song rights are unclear.
- Adjusted default route: favors using the chorus or strongest excerpt, not the entire song.
- Removed old documentation (skill-card.md) and updated SKILL.md for clarity and new logic.
Ask for a top-up before the song clip starts, using the live video price and the starter pack.
Publish the reviewed AI Music Video Clip Maker workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
